title: listOpenLoops
responsibility: Reads loop states, returns open loops filtered by idle age, retains unreadable-loop diagnostics, and orders results by oldest activity.

inputs.name: listOpenLoops.input
inputs.description: The options passed to listOpenLoops and its loop-root and clock helpers, with an optional staleDays threshold. The function defaults omitted input to {} and an omitted staleDays value to 0.

inputs.name: renderOpenLoops.list
inputs.description: An OpenLoopList containing loop rows and unreadable-loop diagnostics to render. The function preserves the supplied loop order and appends unreadable diagnostics after loop lines.

inputs.name: renderOpenLoops.staleDays
inputs.description: Controls only the heading: values greater than zero produce an idle-for-N+-days scope, while zero or negative values produce an open scope. It defaults to zero and does not filter the supplied list.

outputs.name: listOpenLoops
outputs.description: Resolves to open loops that meet the optional idle-day threshold, sorted by oldest activity, plus unreadable entries collected while reading individual loops. A missing loop directory is an empty set; a non-missing error while listing it rejects the promise.

outputs.name: renderOpenLoops
outputs.description: Returns one line per loop, or a no-results line when no loops are present, followed by unreadable diagnostics; the lines are joined with newlines. The heading uses staleDays, but the supplied list is not filtered.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when staleDays is not a nonnegative safe integer. Validation happens before loop enumeration.

errors.name: Loop directory listing failure
errors.description: A non-missing error from listing the loop directory is rethrown, so listOpenLoops rejects. A missing loop directory is treated as an empty set.
